items.title: 68728_Jonah
items.q: George Shearing used to go in there and break it up.

ctx.x: I don't know. We went into Baker's and nobody knew us much you know, and we went into Baker's. And George Shearing used to go in there and break it up. But we went in there for the first time, you know, and no records, but Jonah Jones at the Embers, and probably nobody played it out there. So we went in and didn't do too good. Then he started booking us into -- you know Sam Goody up there -- I mean -- Goody, up in Canada, at the --
